title: GitPress site configuration (gitpress.json)
description: Lives at the root of a GitPress data repository. schemaVersion is bumped only for breaking changes; new fields are always additive and optional.

schemaVersion.description: Spec version of this file. Builders must refuse versions they do not understand instead of guessing.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag, e.g. en, zh-CN.

url.description: Canonical site URL, e.g. https://alice.github.io/my-blog. Used for sitemap/RSS/absolute links.

basePath.description: Path prefix the site is served under (GitHub Pages project sites use /<repo>/).

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai. Public pages format dates here; unzoned frontmatter dates are interpreted in this zone at build time.

logo.description: Public path to the site logo, typically /media/logo-….png. Lives on site so it survives theme switches. Themes decide visibility via theme.config.showLogo.

avatar.description: Public path to a circular author/site avatar, typically /media/avatar-….png. Themes decide visibility via theme.config.showAvatar.

categories.description: Ordered, site-owner-maintained categories. Themes render /categories/<slug>/ archive pages for every entry, and top nav links for those with inNav !== false. Distinct from posts' free-form tags — each post picks at most one category from this list.

inNav.description: When false, omit this category from the generated site's top navigation. Archive pages and post assignment are unaffected. Missing means true.

postsPerPage.description: Posts per page for the homepage and category archives.

analyticsSnippet.description: Raw HTML/script snippet inserted verbatim before </head> on every page. When site.analytics.providers is present, builders compile enabled providers into this field. Empty/absent means no analytics are injected.

analytics.description: Structured analytics providers for the GitPress UI. Themes must ignore this and insert analyticsSnippet only. Disabled providers are kept but not compiled into the published site.

dashboardUrl.description: Optional https URL of the provider dashboard.

comments.description: Site-level comments. enabled is independent of whether giscus is connected — turning it off hides the widget without dropping giscus. When enabled is absent, themes treat comments as on if giscus or commentsSnippet is present.

repoId.description: GitHub GraphQL node id of that repo.

commentsSnippet.description: Legacy raw embed snippet used only when comments.giscus is absent. Empty/absent means no fallback.

nav.description: Explicit, ordered top-nav menu maintained by the site owner. When present, this is the only source of truth for the generated site's navigation (including whether Home/RSS appear at all). When absent, themes fall back to Home + inNav categories + pages; RSS belongs in the footer unless the owner adds it here. Item labels may be overridden; default Home/RSS copy should follow site.language.

slug.description: Required for type 'category' (matches site.categories[].slug) and type 'page' (matches the page's slug).

label.description: Display text override. Required for type 'link'; optional for every other type, which otherwise derive a default label (category label, page title, "Home", "RSS").

footer.description: Explicit footer. When present, themes render exactly these items (then site.beian). When absent, default is copyright + GitPress + theme credit + RSS, all hideable. System types: copyright, gitpress, theme, rss. Custom types are only page, link, text. Unknown types: render as link if url+label, else plain text if label. copyright labels may include {year}. theme has no url here — resolve from the active theme.json homepage.

beian.description: Mainland China ICP / public-security filing. Themes append this after footer items when set. Not a footer list entry (cannot be hidden except by clearing the fields).

icp.description: MIIT ICP number, e.g. 京ICP备12345678号. Linked to https://beian.miit.gov.cn/

gongan.description: MPS filing recordcode (digits). Linked to the official query page with a shield icon.

source.description: Where to fetch the theme. Formats: 'builtin' (resolved from the official GitPress themes monorepo), 'github:<owner>/<repo>[/<subdir>]#<ref>', or 'npm:<package>@<version>'.

ref.description: Pinned version/tag/commit of the theme. Builders must never float to latest implicitly.

config.description: Theme-specific options, validated against the theme's theme.json configSchema.

includeDrafts.description: Safety valve for previews. Public builds must keep this false.

output.description: Build output directory inside the theme project.

plugins.description: Reserved for the GitPress plugin system (spec v1 does not execute plugins; builders must ignore unknown entries without failing).
